purpose: Explain the F-ROSS15 Reference-faster screening result by attributing numerical work and profile cost without modifying either solver.

domain.case_authority: same 36 PUB-P2E10 paired-valid E0 cases used by F-ROSS15

diagnostic_stage_1_work_counts.execution: one untimed solve per route per case after normal initialization
diagnostic_stage_1_work_counts.reason: production kernel executes 8-step coarse + 8-step first half + 8-step second half for the temporal certificate

profile_variants.interpretation: closest available function-level profile to F-ROSS15 build, subject to profiler instrumentation and compiler inlining
structural attribution only; not a production timing ratio

diagnostic_stage_2_profile.claim_rule: Use work-count evidence as exact structural evidence. Treat gprof percentages as diagnostic attribution, not as formal production performance shares.

hypotheses_pre_execution: H1: RossFast successful solves execute exactly 24 linear solves because temporal certification evaluates coarse plus two half trajectories.
H2: Reference requires materially fewer linear solves on this E0 domain.
H3: RossFast cost is dominated by repeated candidate-step work rather than the 16x16 tridiagonal factor-and-solve itself.
H4: table interpolation and repeated constitutive/state inversion may account for a substantial share of candidate-step cost.

negative_result_policy.if_gprof_sampling_is_unresolved: record PROFILE_UNRESOLVED and rely only on exact work-count attribution

next_permitted_action: Implement qualification-only work-count and profiling harnesses exactly as preregistered and execute them.
